name: two_phase_nonboiling_in_tube
title: In-tube two-phase non-boiling heat-transfer coefficients (function library)
summary: Nine EES FUNCTIONs returning the forced-convection heat-transfer coefficient of a liquid and a gas flowing inside a tube without phase change (condensing or evaporating): Davis-David, Elamvaluthi-Srinivas, Groothuis-Hendal (air-water and gas/air-oil forms), Hughmark and Aggour (laminar slug / horizontal and vertical), Knott, Kudirka-Grosh-McFadden, Martin-Sims and Ravipudi-Godbold. Each returns h_tp [W/m^2/K] from the mass flow rate, the quality and the liquid and gas properties, which are arguments: no property function is called inside the functions.

authors: E. J. Davis and M. M. David (Davis-David correlation, 1964)
G. Elamvaluthi and N. S. Srinivas (Elamvaluthi-Srinivas correlation, 1984)
H. Groothuis and W. P. Hendal (Groothuis-Hendal correlation, 1959)
R. F. Knott, R. N. Anderson, A. Acrivos and E. E. Petersen (Knott correlation, 1959)
A. A. Kudirka, R. J. Grosh and P. W. McFadden (Kudirka-Grosh-McFadden correlation, 1965)
B. W. Martin and G. E. Sims (Martin-Sims correlation, 1971)
S. Ravipudi and T. Godbold (Ravipudi-Godbold correlation, 1978)
Mohamed A. Aggour (Aggour correlation, Ph.D. thesis, 1978)
